examTitle: Signals and Systems Exam (HS 2019, 6 February 2020) - multiple-choice parts only

questions.question: Consider the signal $u[n]=1+\cos(\pi n)$ for all $n$ processed by the system $y_1[n]=y_1[n-1]+0.5(u[n]-y_1[n-1])$, $y_2[n]=u[n]-y_1[n]$. Which of the following plots is the output $y_2[n]$?

Let $\{u[n]\}=\{n\,s[n-1]\}$ be the input sequence applied to the causal LTI system $G$. Which of the following block diagrams could represent the transfer function of $G$ if the output is $\{y[n]\}=\{s[n-2]\}$?

options.A: Parallel connection (summed) of the blocks $-z^{-2}$ and $z^{-1}$
options.B: Parallel connection of the block $z^{-1}$ and a direct path (gain 1)
options.C: Parallel connection of the blocks $\frac{1}{z-2}$ and $z^{-1}$
options.D: Parallel connection of the block $\frac{1}{2-z}$ and a direct path (gain 1)

questions.question: Consider an LTI system $G$ with $G\neq0$. Is the following statement guaranteed to be true? If $u$ is a complex exponential sequence with frequency $\Omega$, then $y=Gu$ has the same frequency as $u$.

Consider an LTI system $G$ with $G\neq0$. Is the following statement guaranteed to be true? If $u[n]=\cos(\Omega_1n)+\cos(\Omega_2n)$ is the input to $G$, and $\Omega=\Omega_1+\Omega_2$, the output of $G$ is $y[n]=|H(\Omega)|\cos(\Omega n+\Theta_H(\Omega))$.

Consider an LTI system $G$ with $G\neq0$. Is the following statement guaranteed to be true? If $u[n]=e^{j\Omega n}$ is the input to $G$, and $G$ is the cascade of two LTI systems $G_1$ and $G_2$, the output of $G$ is $y[n]=|H_1(\Omega)||H_2(\Omega)|e^{j(\Omega n+\Theta_{H_1}(\Omega)+\Theta_{H_2}(\Omega))}$.

Consider an LTI system $G$ with $G\neq0$. Is the following statement guaranteed to be true? If $u[n]=(-1)^n+\cos(\Omega n)$ is the input to $G$, the output is $y[n]=|H(\Omega)|\cos(\Omega n+\Theta_H(\Omega))+|H(0)|\cos(\Theta_H(0))$.
Consider the discrete-time system $G$ described by $y[n]=0.5y[n-2]+u[n]-u[n-2]$. Determine the magnitude response $|H(\Omega)|$ of system $G$.

Consider the discrete-time system $G$ described by $y[n]=0.5y[n-2]+u[n]-u[n-2]$. Consider the low-pass filter $G_{LP}$ with the magnitude response $|W(\Omega)|$ shown in the figure, with z-transform $W(z)$. Determine which of the following approximations is true.
